purpose: Persistent real-fill journal for Teststock. Reconcile this file from Robinhood order/position/history data before using it for learning.

persistence.instructions: Claude should write a nonce on one run and verify the same nonce is readable on a later scheduled run. If persistence cannot be verified, mark FAILED/UNVERIFIED, reconstruct recent statistics from Robinhood history, and never use missing persistence to increase risk.

tradeRecordSchema.journalId: stable unique id derived from Robinhood order ids when possible
tradeRecordSchema.setupType: STOCK_TREND | OPTION_ELITE_CALL | OPTION_ELITE_PUT | CRYPTO_A | CRYPTO_A_PLUS | OTHER | UNKNOWN
tradeRecordSchema.riskCluster: Teststock correlationGuard cluster name or UNKNOWN
tradeRecordSchema.exitReason: STOP | TARGET1 | TARGET2 | TRAILING_PROTECTION | MANUAL | OTHER | UNKNOWN

rules: Robinhood order, fill, position, and account history is authoritative. Never invent missing fills or prices.
Update an existing trade by stable order identifiers instead of creating duplicates.
A trade is resolved only after the live position is closed and Robinhood history confirms the exit.
Use actual average fill prices for realized P&L and realized-R calculations.
Record execution telemetry only when the connected runtime exposes the value; never infer missing bid/ask, timestamps, or order states.
Compute performance and adverse slippage overall, by setupType, by riskCluster, and by symbol when sample sizes are sufficient.
Never let strong aggregate performance hide a weak setupType, riskCluster, or execution-quality bucket.
Keep modeled Teststock history and shadow-trade diagnostics separate from real-money Robinhood results.
If Robinhood history is incomplete or contradictory, mark fields UNKNOWN and do not use that trade to increase risk.
